direct_labels.anti_leakage: Do not infer bidder team from final score or rollout result.
direct_labels.name: is_setter_decision
direct_labels.negative_condition: The acting player is on the bidder team.
direct_labels.positive_condition: The acting player is on the defending team.

direct_labels.anti_leakage: Use only points captured before the candidate action, not terminal hand totals.
direct_labels.definition: normalized bid, declaration, ruleset, and points already captured by bidder team and defender team
direct_labels.name: contract_context
direct_labels.negative_condition: Unknown bidder, bid amount, declaration, or captured points.
direct_labels.positive_condition: Contract fields are present and internally consistent.

direct_labels.anti_leakage: Do not use hidden count still held by other players as live availability; only use candidate action and public trick count.
direct_labels.definition: A public threshold window where candidate count can bring the bidder team to or below set threshold, or materially reduce the remaining allowance.
direct_labels.name: count_to_set_window
direct_labels.negative_condition: Candidate count cannot affect the public make/set threshold under current contract accounting.
direct_labels.positive_condition: Candidate count can cross the public set threshold or move the hand into a one-count-away set state.

direct_labels.anti_leakage: Do not mark positive only because a hidden defender tile would win; the live label must be explainable from public voids, current winner, and legal actions.
direct_labels.definition: The current trick is in a non-trump/non-declaration suit that is publicly vulnerable for bidder team and can be won by a defender or defender's partner.
direct_labels.name: bidder_off_window
direct_labels.negative_condition: The trick is trump/declaration control, the acting player is forced into non-count follow with no count choice, or public state gives no bidder-off exposure.
direct_labels.positive_condition: A defender is acting while bidder team is exposed on an off-suit trick and public void/legal-action evidence makes a defender win or partner win plausible.

direct_labels.anti_leakage: Public certainty may use legal-action constraints and public voids, but not hidden later-player hands.
direct_labels.definition: A candidate count action by a setter before the final trick winner is publicly certain.
direct_labels.name: count_before_certainty
direct_labels.negative_condition: Candidate is not count, the trick winner is already public-certain, or the action is not by a setter.
direct_labels.positive_condition: candidate_count_points > 0 and at least one later player can legally change the current winner under public state.

direct_labels.anti_leakage: This is a window label, not a claim that every count action is optimal.
direct_labels.definition: is_setter_decision and bidder_off_window and count_to_set_window with at least one legal count action available to the setter.
direct_labels.name: setter_pounce_window
direct_labels.negative_condition: Any gate is absent, or only non-count legal actions exist.
direct_labels.positive_condition: All three public gates hold and at least one legal action carries count.

direct_labels.anti_leakage: Do not use oracle regret to decide whether an action receives this structural label.
direct_labels.definition: Legal candidate count action inside setter_pounce_window.
direct_labels.name: setter_pounce_action
direct_labels.negative_condition: Window is absent or action has no count.
direct_labels.positive_condition: Action is legal and candidate_count_points > 0 inside a setter_pounce_window.

direct_labels.anti_leakage: Allowed only as training/eval target or report metric, never as live policy input.
direct_labels.definition: Offline report label measuring how the action changes sampled-world mass at or below the set threshold for bidder team.
direct_labels.name: threshold_mass_delta
direct_labels.positive_condition: Action increases defender set probability by at least configured threshold tau versus non-count alternatives in same decision.

direct_labels.anti_leakage: Hidden branch labels remain offline diagnostics.
direct_labels.definition: Offline report label for lower-tail bidder-team outcome change, including CVaR or low-quantile shift.
direct_labels.name: disaster_tail_mitigation_delta
direct_labels.positive_condition: Action materially worsens bidder-team lower tail or improves defender-team lower tail relative to alternatives.

hidden_state_forbidden_live: unplayed domino owner truth outside current player's hand
forge E[Q], E[Q] PDF, sampled-world outcome branches, or completed-hand set attribution
offline_label_allowed: forge E[Q] and E[Q] PDF deltas
public_state_allowed: current player seat and team relation to bidder team
public auction winner, bid amount, declaration, and ruleset metadata
current hand/trick score visible in the public state
public trick history including played tiles, trick winners, captured count, and public void evidence
current trick position and current public winning seat
legal action set and action-local tile facts

scope: first-pass direct labels for setter pounce and count-to-set windows
